name: AI Assistant
author: Viboplr
description: An AI assistant inside Viboplr, running on your own model: a local one (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp), Claude, OpenAI, Grok or any OpenAI-compatible service. Ask for music in plain words, fill albums, find upgrades, tidy messy titles and tags, and read about what's playing. It uses the same tools an outside AI assistant gets, and asks before changing anything.

viewHeader.subtitle: Your music, asked in plain words

apiUsage.reason: Talk to the model endpoint you configure (local or remote), and read web pages the assistant cites when you ask for more information
Use Viboplr's own AI tools (search, play, tags, downloads…) — the same ones an outside assistant gets, behind the same AI control switches
Read a track's cached lyrics to explain or translate them
Fetch lyrics through your lyrics providers when none are cached yet
Remember your provider, endpoint, API keys and model

informationTypes.name: Meaning
informationTypes.description: What the lyrics are about, written by your AI model from the cached lyrics

assistant.instructions: A language model the user configured (local or remote). complete runs one prompt through it and returns the text — use it from another plugin to summarise, classify or rewrite without configuring a model of your own.

tools.name: complete
tools.description: Run one prompt through the user's configured model and return its answer as text (or parsed JSON with json=true). Read-only: the model has no tools here.

json.description: Ask for a JSON object and parse it

fast.description: Use the configured fast model if there is one
